column2: req_desc

Health and one origin
`GET /api/health` answers 200 once the app is ready, and the same origin serves the pages and the API under `/api`.

Seed on first boot
On first boot, with no manual step, the store holds exactly the programmes, desk accounts, references, result figures, notes, enquiries and service clock row listed in Seed data, each once, and nothing else.

Stored entities
The nine entities live in their own Postgres tables named in Data model, each with the columns listed there.

Substituted media
The served pages carry no video element and load no file from any other origin.

Nothing sold, no comments
The product exposes none of the sign-up, search, checkout, comment or reaction endpoints listed in Server boundary.

One live set
Every public read answers with the live references of the served programme and nothing else, so drafts, withheld references, retired references and the other programme's references never appear.

Index API
`GET /api/references` lists the live references in display order with the index fields listed in API, their ordinals running contiguously from one.

Detail API
`GET /api/references/{slug}` returns a live reference with the detail fields listed in API, including its result figures in order.

Reference index page
`/references` shows the index title, a count that matches its rows, the sector filter of live sectors only and one server-rendered row per live reference whose link names the reference title.

Empty index
An index with no reference to show states the empty-state sentence with the enquiry call to action instead of a blank page.

Detail page
`/references/<slug>` shows the reference with its result figures as labelled pairs and carries a title, a description and a social preview image in its head.

Home page
The home page shows the promise line in the hero, the featured strip of the first three live references and the service panels.

Reading routes
`/programme` offers four chapters, `/story` dated chapters with described images, and `/notes` dated notes newest first with no undated draft.

Unknown address
An address that matches no route answers 404 with the not-found page and a link home, never a redirect.

Withheld everywhere
A reference outside its clearance window is absent from the index, the home strip, the sector filter, the enquiry choices and the Finnish mirror, and its detail address answers 404.

Future window
A reference whose clearance window has not opened yet is withheld exactly like one whose window has closed.

Enquiry accepted
A valid enquiry answers 201, is stored with its agreement flag and reference of interest, and appears in the desk queue of the serving programme, newest first.

Enquiry refused
An enquiry with a missing or malformed address, no agreement, a short telephone number or a reference that is not live answers 422 with an `errors` map and writes nothing.

One open enquiry per address
A repeat from an address with an open enquiry joins it and keeps its first arrival time, simultaneous repeats leave one row, and once the earlier one is closed a new enquiry is its own record.

Contact route
`/contact` shows the directory of six reference managers with their copy buttons and the enquiry form with labelled fields, the required ones marked, and the submit button.

Enquiry form states
While the enquiry is in flight the submit button is disabled; success replaces the form with a confirmation naming the reply address; a refusal or an outage keeps the typing and shows its message.

Copy address control
Each directory card's copy button is operable from the keyboard, copies the address and swaps its label to the confirmation copy.

Sign in
`POST /api/auth/login` returns a bearer token for each seeded account, and every failed sign in answers 401 with one byte-identical body whether or not the address is known.

Hashed passwords
No stored account row contains a password in the clear.

Desk needs a session
A desk call carrying no bearer token, an unknown one or an ended one is refused 401.

Steward-only actions
A curator recording a clearance window or deleting an enquiry is refused 403 by the server and nothing changes, the refusal naming neither the stored dates nor the role, while a steward may do both; a request naming a role, programme, account, publication state, ordinal or window outside its own endpoint is answered as though it had named none.

Programme isolation
A desk request for another programme's reference, enquiry, preview link or ordinal answers 404 and changes nothing, and every desk list holds only the account's own programme.

Drafts and edits
A curator creates a reference as an unpublished draft with no ordinal and no window, and edits its editable fields, figures included.

Publication
Publishing a reference with at least one result figure whose recorded window contains today appends it at the end of the ordinal run, in the English and Finnish indexes at once.

Publication guards
Publishing with no recorded clearance window or no result figure, or publishing a reference that is already published, answers 409, and no such refusal moves the ordinal run or mints a preview link.

Ordinal moves
Retiring, a closing window, restoring and reordering keep the live ordinals contiguous from one; a restore and a position past the end both land last, and moving a reference that is not live is refused 409.

Concurrent publishes
Simultaneous publish requests for one reference produce one publication and one ordinal.

Preview links
A preview link carries an opaque token and an expiry and opens exactly its own unpublished reference, refusing every other slug, every moment after its expiry and every link it has been replaced by.

Preview retired by publication
Publishing a reference retires every preview link minted for it, so a link held from before publication no longer opens it once it is withdrawn.

Preview banner
A detail page opened through a valid preview link shows the preview banner without the enquiry call to action, and a page without a valid link shows no banner.

Renames redirect
Renaming a live reference moves it to the new slug, and every earlier address, in both languages and the API, redirects permanently to the current one.

Retired addresses
A retired reference answers 404 at every address it has ever held.

Finnish mirror
Every public route answers under `/fi`, and the Finnish read API serves the same live set with a detail for every live reference.

Finnish copy
The Finnish surface uses the published Finnish wording for navigation, labels, validation messages and the not-found page, and shows the pending-translation note only for a reference with no Finnish body.

Language switch and declarations
The language switch keeps the current route and its query, and each document declares its language and names the other language address, query included, as its alternate.

Global chrome
Every public route has one header and one footer, the footer carrying the sitemap, the programme name with the current year and the privacy link, and the navigation marks exactly the current page.

Cookie notice
The cookie notice appears on a first visit, no analytics cookie is set before it is answered, and it does not return once answered.

Conformance at desktop width
The home page, reference index, a reference detail, the programme, story, notes and contact routes pass a WCAG 2.2 AA audit at 1280 by 800.

Conformance at phone width
The home page and the reference index pass a WCAG 2.2 AA audit at 375 by 812.

Headings, keyboard and icons
Each public route has one level-one heading with no skipped levels, the skip link is the first keyboard stop, every keyboard stop shows the same visible focus ring and every icon is named or hidden.

Reflow at 320 pixels
The home page, reference index, programme, story and contact routes show no sideways scrolling at 320 pixels wide.

Enlarged text, targets and images
The index holds with text at twice its size, every interactive target, links inside text included, is at least 24 by 24 pixels at phone width, and every image carries explicit dimensions.

Motion and reduced motion
An index row lifts and its title darkens under the pointer, the promise line holds while the featured strip moves on, and a reduced-motion reader gets every end state with no animation on the home page, chapter panels or desk.

Editorial composition
The home page, reference index and contact route read as a printed editorial page with content on the ground rather than inside dashboard panels.

Palette
The page sits on a warm off-white ground with near-black ink and a soft lime fill on the enquiry calls to action, the header link and the home Start an enquiry link included.

Type
Display titles use a light transitional serif with tight line spacing while running prose uses a medium grotesque sans.

Index rows
The reference index is one column of full-width rows divided only by hairlines, with no cards and no shadows.

Narrow layout
At phone width the index keeps space at both edges and breaks titles only between words.

Shared article parts
The chapter, pull quote and figure pair keep one treatment on the programme and story routes.

Desk working surface
Signed in, `/desk` shows the account's references as a working list with editing controls beside each row, visibly unlike the public index.

Only the published surface
Unlisted `/api` paths answer a JSON 404, a listed path called with an unlisted method answers a JSON 405 with an `Allow` header, no framework documentation or debug route is served, and a body that is not a JSON object answers 422 with `errors.body`.

Filter state lives in the address
The sector filter is rendered on the server from the address, survives the language switch and the alternate link, and a withheld, draft-only, other-programme or unknown sector reads as the same empty filter.

Window edges
Clearance windows are judged by Helsinki calendar dates inclusive at both ends, impossible or inverted windows are refused 422, publishing against an ended window is refused 409, narrowing withdraws at once and reopening appends the reference last, as qualified in Business rules.

Only editable fields are written
Creating or editing a reference writes only the editable fields listed in API and ignores every other key in the body, the slug always coming from the title.

Keyboard reorder on the desk
Each live desk row carries move up and move down buttons that reorder from the keyboard, keep focus on the moved row, announce the new position and restore the server order on refusal.

Preview refusals look alike
Every refused preview answers the same 404 body and page as a missing reference, a valid preview is served uncacheable and unindexed, and an expiry outside the allowed range is refused 422.

The service clock
Every reading of now, on every surface, is the system instant plus the stored `service_clock` offset read fresh for each request, and no route exposes that offset.

Recovery without restart
With Postgres stopped every database route answers the published 503 within 5 seconds, service resumes without an app restart once it returns, and a boot with Postgres absent retries and then applies the seed exactly once.

Hostile input
NUL characters, lone surrogates, non-integer ordinals, loose date forms, NaN and deep nesting are refused with the published status and shape and never answer 5xx, as qualified in API.

Exact breakpoints
Layouts change exactly at 640 and 1100 pixels wide, and an open menu stays coherent across a resize.

Collapsed means unavailable
A closed chapter, a closed menu and a dismissed cookie notice leave the tab order and the accessibility tree from the moment closing starts.

Chapter addresses
The fragments `nomination`, `clearance`, `duration` and `changes` open their chapter below the fixed header from the quick navigation, a direct load or Back, and the language switch carries the current fragment.

Focus never hidden
Every keyboard stop is entirely clear of the fixed header and the open cookie notice when it takes focus, at every published width and at twice the text size.

Rollover under load
When the Helsinki date changes by one day or several, simultaneous mixed public and desk requests all answer without a 5xx and each sees the one correct run.

The desk takes state from the server
Row state, move buttons and expiry text on the desk come only from server data, whatever the browser's clock or time zone, and a stale action shows its refusal and re-reads the list.

A clearance covers the content
Changing the figures, quote, quote speaker, quote role or customer of a reference clears its recorded window in the same transaction, while identical values void nothing, as qualified in Business rules.

Announced enquiry results
Enquiry confirmations, refusals and outages are announced from live regions already in the page, each field error is tied to its field, and a retry after an outage succeeds with one request and the typing intact.

The copy control's timer
The copy confirmation lasts about two seconds from the latest activation on each card independently, focus stays on the button, and a refused clipboard shows the refusal label and selects the address.

Sessions end and the action resumes
A session lasts 8 hours from sign-in inclusive on the service clock, and a desk action caught by its end keeps the typing and resumes once after sign-in, as qualified in Interactions.

Authority read from the stored account
A changed role or programme applies on the next request under an existing token, a deleted account's token answers 401, and parallel requests from different accounts never see each other's rows.

Landing after each desk action
Sign-in and every desk action leave the address at `/desk` with the published screen state, and reloading in the same tab keeps the session while a new tab asks to sign in.

Keyboard-complete desk
The whole draft, figures, publish and retire flow works from the keyboard, each action landing on its published focus target and focus never falling to the page.

The editor survives list re-reads
A completed action on another row re-reads the list without losing the editor's typed values, caret position or row, and desk messages stay until the next action.

Live desk totals
The desk's reference totals, open enquiry count and figure count update in place after every completed action, always equal the rows shown and are unchanged by a refusal.

Lost updates
`PATCH` honours an optional `If-Match` against the reference's version, a mismatch answers 412 and changes nothing, and the desk always sends it and keeps the typing on a refusal.

Wider concurrency
Simultaneous publishes of different references award contiguous distinct ordinals, simultaneous creates with one title all succeed with distinct slugs, and publish or move racing retire leaves a contiguous run.

Elapsed-time expiry
Preview expiry counts elapsed seconds across daylight-saving changes, a link is valid at its expiry second and refused one second later, and the desk shows the expiry in correct Helsinki local time.

Previews leak nothing
Refused previews match a missing reference in status, body and headers, a valid preview page keeps its token out of every link but the language links, and renames and retirement treat a link as Business rules decides.

Exact restore
Publishing a retired reference brings back its content, figures, window and every earlier slug's redirect exactly, last in the run, with old preview links still dead.

Redirect fidelity
An earlier-slug redirect is one permanent hop that keeps the query string byte for byte, stays on the configured origin whatever the request headers claim, and is never served for a non-live reference.

Slugs from real text
Slugs come from the title in composed form, a title yielding no slug is refused 422, clashes count every current and earlier slug in the programme, and a change of case alone writes no history.

Published Finnish wording
Every string in the published Finnish table renders character for character on Finnish routes in its state, including singular counts, refusals, outages and the clipboard refusal.

Language of parts and dates
Any block in the other language carries its own language marking, and note dates read in the published English and Finnish forms.

Address fidelity and Finnish order
The language links keep the raw query byte for byte on every page kind, doubled or desk Finnish addresses answer not found, and non-live desk rows sort in Finnish alphabetical order.

Live motion preference
Changing the reduced-motion preference on an open page applies at once with no reload, and reverting it restores the effect, the promise line travelling about a quarter of the strip's distance.

Reference state machine
Desk lists and details report each reference's state as draft, live, withheld or retired, only the published edges change it, and each row shows the same word.

Repeated desk announcements
The same desk message twice in a row is announced as a fresh change each time, focus stays in the row or editor while a request is in flight, and a rapid double press of a move sends one request.

`/app/run.json` exists with `"_schema":"run-manifest-v1"`, non-empty string `install` and `serve` commands and a string `build` command, so the app can be brought up from cold on a machine that has only `/app`.
`/app/USER_README.md` lists every seeded desk account as an `Email:` line followed by its `Password:` line, exactly as in Deployment.

`/app/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` names every shipped package and font with its licence; shipped packages means the production dependency tree (the packages your `install` command installs for Python, and `npm ls --omit=dev --all --json` if any npm packages ship).
Every shipped package carries one of MIT, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, ISC, PSF-2.0, MPL-2.0 or LGPL-3.0, and every shipped font carries the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
The app stores data only in the Postgres database at `DATABASE_URL`: no SQLite file, no other database server, no cache server.
`/app/IMAGE_MANIFEST.md` lists every image file the app serves, with its origin and its licence.
The provided development service configuration for Postgres is left unchanged.
Python dependencies install into a `.venv` inside `/app`, and the manifest calls tools by `.venv/bin/<tool>` or `python -m <tool>`.
